text:
erin: Heads up: we're planning a coordinated SDK unpin for 3.4.4 -> 3.5.0 across dedicated pools tomorrow. There's a new runtime compatibility flag in 3.5.0 that could break delta-kv handling. Want to sketch the gating and roll schedule.

simon: good catch. Which dedicated pools are on schedule? I can delay for the larger customers if needed.

deploybot: scheduled action: unpin sdk:3.4.4 -> 3.5.0 at 3190012000 (tomorrow 10:00 UTC) across dedicated: small, med, large pools (staggered).

nick: delta-kv handling was changed in runtime v2.17 to assume new SDK behavior. If any dedicated customer is pinned to runtime<v2.17, they'll see runtime errors. We need compatibility sweep.

ersin: (typo) erin: good point. We should run a compatibility sweep: list all dedicated clusters and check runtime pin version.

opsbot: compatibility sweep queued. ETA 12m. Will report clusters out-of-date.

monitor-bot: quick note: customer "bigco" on dedicated-large has runtime pinned at v2.15 due to regulatory SLA. They will be incompatible with SDK 3.5.0 until runtime is upgraded or we keep SDK pinned.

simon: we need an exception path. Options: A) skip bigco dedicated-large from the SDK unpin (keep 3.4.4) B) schedule a runtime upgrade for bigco (needs customer approval + 48h) C) opt them into a shim that makes 3.5.0 compatible with runtime<v2.17.

erin: prefer A for tomorrow's window to avoid disruption. We'll document exception and schedule runtime upgrade separately.

simon: agreed. Implementing exception: deploybot, exclude customer:bigco from SDK unpin across dedicated-large.

deploybot: action updated: exclude customer:bigco from sdk:3.5.0 unpin.

nick: also add a preflight check to fail the unpin if any dedicated clusters still report runtime<2.17 besides the allowed exceptions list.

erin: yes. Add compatibility gate and post a release-note blurb for customers. Also include the rollback snippet for quick pin if errors: 
```
# quick pin
deploybot pin sdk:3.4.4 --scope=dedicated-large --filter=customer:bigco --reason="incompat-runtime"
```

opsbot: preflight sweep results: 4 clusters flagged (bigco dedicated-large, partnerx dedicated-med pinned v2.16, internal-test dedicated-small v2.14, edge-legacy dedicated-small v2.15).

erin: based on that, update exception list to include partnerx dedicated-med for tomorrow, we can coordinate runtime upgrade with them next week. Do not proceed for internal-test (we'll exclude test pool).

simon: will notify sales/customer success for partnerx and bigco. We'll need a tailored plan.

deploybot: final plan: unpin sdk -> 3.5.0 at 10:00 UTC excluding clusters: customer:bigco(dedicated-large), partnerx(dedicated-med), internal-test(dedicated-small), edge-legacy(dedicated-small). Preflight compatibility gate enabled. rollback-hook: 45m.

erin: add a release-note item: "SDK 3.5.0 rollout scheduled. Exceptions applied for clusters running runtime < v2.17. Customers on exception list will be contacted by CS."

nick: one last ask: include a canary progression that starts with hosted canaries, then dedicated-small (non-exception), then med/large. Also add a telemetry breakpoint: if token-level 5xx > 0.5% in 10m window, abort.

deploybot: updated rollout: hosted canary -> dedicated-small -> dedicated-med -> dedicated-large (excluding exceptions). Telemetry breakpoint added.

ersin: (typo) erin: I'll own the post-rollout notes and CS comms. Simon, can you lead the customer runtime upgrade plan?

simon: yep. I'll open follow-ups.

erin: thanks team. Scheduling done. Closing thread.
